summary: qzc690385 setup.py uses local Xinference registry as a C2 dead-drop to run shell commands at install time
details: On `pip install`, setup.py contacts the local Xinference REST API at http://127.0.0.1:9997/v1/model_registrations/flexible, enumerates registered model names, and selects entries whose names begin with 'xcmd0'. The suffix of each such name is base64-decoded and the resulting string is passed to /bin/sh -c via subprocess.run, giving arbitrary shell execution on the installer host. The stdout/stderr of the executed command is base64-encoded and written back into the same Xinference registry as new model registrations with names prefixed 'zqx9p00'/'zqx9p01'/'zqx9p02', chunked to fit the name field. This turns an unrelated local service's model registry into a bidirectional command/response channel: anyone able to create model registrations on that Xinference instance obtains shell execution on every host that installs this package, and the command output is readable back through the same registry. The behavior is unrelated to any documented purpose of the package and fires automatically during a default sdist build on all listed platforms.
